description:
Presenting the official full song video of the soundtrack 'Yeh Haseen Vadiyan Yeh Khula Aasman' from the 1992 Internationally acclaimed romantic thriller movie - “Roja (Hindi)" starring Arvind Swami and Madhoo in the lead role.
The movie is written and directed by Mani Ratnam, music is composed by A.R. Rahman and lyrics by P K Mishra.

#roja #yehhaseenvadiyan #arrahman #maniratnam #madhoo #arvindswami

Music – A.R. Rahman
